entities.summary: Bogdan Alexandrovich Kiselevich is a Russian professional ice hockey defenceman who is currently a free agent. He last played for Lokomotiv Yaroslavl in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He has formerly played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Florida Panthers.
